body.heading: Lip Blush Beginner Course programme
paragraphs: Day 1 — Online preparation (10 hours, flexible to schedule): an introduction to permanent makeup and the Lip Blush technique; anatomy of the skin and lips and how these influence the pigmentation; in-depth colour theory on choosing and combining shades; lip mapping, shaping and design including practical demonstrations; theory on different needles and their applications; hygiene and GGD inspection; the healing process and aftercare of the skin; and salon management with marketing tips.

Day 2 — Theory and basic skills on location (6 hours). Morning (9:30 – 12:00): information about permanent makeup, deepening of the online knowledge and lip pigmentation theory plus an interactive session on hygiene and safety standards, applying colour and pigment theory to practical examples, and practical guidelines for GGD certification and salon setup. Afternoon (12:30 – 15:30): introduction to using the PMU machine from settings to operation, exercises in lip mapping and drawing contours with personal feedback, and practical tips to start your own salon and attract clients.

Day 3 — Practical training on location (6 hours). Morning (9:30 – 12:00): hands-on practice on latex to perfect techniques such as outlines and pixels, with a focus on symmetry and precision. Afternoon (12:30 – 15:30): in-depth training in advanced techniques such as Soft Lips, Full Lips and Ombré Lips, with feedback from trainers to optimise your progress.

Day 4 — Treating a model and certification (6 hours). Morning (9:30 – 12:00): preparing the workspace in line with the hygiene guidelines, and intake and preparation of a live model for a full Lip Blush treatment. Afternoon (12:30 – 15:30): performing the treatment under supervision while applying all the techniques you have learned, before & after photography for your portfolio, and the certificate presentation as your official start as a PMU specialist.

Day 5 — Perform a touch-up treatment on location within 6-8 weeks after the exam. Day 6 — after 6 months an intensive return day with the opportunity to ask questions, review current results through photos and carry out latex work.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about the Lip Blush Beginner Course

items.q: What will you learn during the PMU Lip Blush Beginner Course?
items.a: You learn the most important techniques such as Soft Lips, Full Lips and Ombré Lips. You also receive extensive training in lip mapping and shaping, so you can create symmetrical, natural results. In addition, you learn all about colour theory and pigments to choose the perfect shade for your clients. Our course offers practical experience on latex and models, complemented by personal guidance from experienced trainers.

items.q: Is this course suitable for beginners?
items.a: Yes, our course is specifically designed for beginners without prior experience in permanent makeup. You gain a solid theoretical foundation through our online modules and direct practical experience during the training. In addition, we offer intensive personal guidance with a maximum of 3 students per training.

items.q: What is the difference between PMU lip blushing and lip shading?
items.a: Lip blushing is a popular technique in which the lips are subtly pigmented to create a natural tint and softness. Lip shading adds dimension by creating shadow, which makes the lips look optically fuller. Both techniques are covered in our course, with extra attention to choosing the right pigments and needle techniques.

items.q: Can I start my own PMU salon with this course?
items.a: Absolutely! Our course not only prepares you to carry out treatments, but also offers support in marketing strategies, GGD hygiene rules and salon management. You learn how to set up a professional workspace and how to build your client base. We also offer aftercare through our community, WhatsApp group and access to additional online training modules.

items.q: Which payment options are available?
items.a: We offer flexible payment options, including payment in 2, 4, 6 or 8 instalments without interest. In addition, you can benefit from subsidies, such as support via the UWV. Contact us to discuss which financing options suit you best.

items.q: What is included in the starter kit?
items.a: Our comprehensive starter kit contains everything you need to carry out up to 50 treatments straight away: high-quality pigments for different skin types, needles, latex sheets and mapping tools, and aftercare products for optimal aftercare. With this starter kit you can get to work professionally right away, both during the course and afterwards.

items.q: Can I keep learning after the course?
items.a: Yes, after completing the Beginner Course you can specialise further with our masterclasses, such as the Lip Blush Masterclass, Ombré Powder Brows Masterclass or Fineline Masterclass. These advanced trainings help you take your PMU skills to a higher level.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about the Infralash Course

items.q: Why is the infralash eyeliner technique so popular with clients?
items.a: There are several reasons! Infralash eyeliner gives a subtle and natural appearance. Permanent makeup is perfect for creating a 'no-makeup makeup' effect. The result is also suitable for all skin types and eye shapes.

items.q: What is the difference between infralash and deepliner?
items.a: With infralash, pigment is placed between the lash line for a subtle effect. A deepliner creates a slightly more visible line above or below the lash line, for clients who want more definition without a full eyeliner.

items.q: How do I make sure my client is satisfied after the treatment?
items.a: During the course you learn not only to carry out the treatment, but also how to advise your client on aftercare, including recommending the right aftercare products. A good aftercare plan contributes to high client satisfaction.

items.q: How do I promote infralash treatments?
items.a: In addition to professional before and after photos, you can share client reviews and success stories on social media. Special offers for new clients help your salon grow. These marketing strategies are covered extensively during the course.

items.q: How do I choose the right pigment for different skin types?
items.a: During the course you learn to select pigments based on skin tone and eye colour, taking into account undertones, intensity and the desired natural result. The right choice ensures a natural outcome.

items.q: Can I combine the course with my current work?
items.a: Yes. The online module is set up so that you complete it flexibly at your own pace before the practical day, ideal if you work.

items.q: Which PMU techniques can I learn after infralash?
items.a: Infralash forms a good foundation for ombré brows and lip pigmentation. By adding techniques you expand your client base and your salon's growth opportunities.

hero.text: Become a specialist in laser hair removal — one of the most in-demand treatments in the modern salon.

laser-ontharing-opleiding.intro: Do you want to set yourself apart with one of the most in-demand treatments in the beauty industry? At IZZI Beauty we offer a complete course to become a specialist in Laser Hair Removal — the treatment that is growing rapidly in popularity and is a fixture in modern salons. This treatment is a valuable addition in your salon to rid clients of unwanted hair growth for the long term. No diplomas or prior knowledge are required to take part in this course.

body.heading: Why choose the Laser Hair Removal Training at IZZI Beauty?
paragraphs: Become a Laser Hair Removal Expert: in 2 intensive days you learn everything — from the theory about hair growth, skin types and laser technology to carrying out laser treatments professionally on models. After completion you are fully prepared to treat clients independently and start straight away in your own salon.

Expand your client base and revenue: laser hair removal is one of the most in-demand treatments in the beauty world. By offering this technique you respond to a growing need and create a stable source of returning clients and revenue.

Exam in small groups for maximum guidance: we offer personal guidance in small groups of a maximum of 2 students, with 1 trainer present. This gives you the attention and guidance you need to start with confidence.

After enrolment and payment you receive access to the IZZI Online Academy by email. Start learning as early as 30 days before the course through extensive videos and informative modules. This online training, prepares you optimally and is available via your phone, tablet or laptop. You keep lifetime access.

Optional machine purchase: request more information about purchasing a laser device — we offer several options. IZZI Beauty is a recognised training institute, CRKBO-registered, and we work together with the UWV.

body.heading: Laser Hair Removal Course programme with Certificate
paragraphs: Become a specialist in safely and effectively removing unwanted hair growth with this professional training from IZZI Beauty. We combine the latest laser techniques with years of expertise in beauty and skin treatments.

Whether you already work in the beauty industry or want to start as a laser hair removal specialist, we give you the right knowledge, practical experience and personal guidance, so you can treat clients with full confidence and get to work successfully straight away in your own salon.

body.heading: Day 1: Online preparation (3 hours)
paragraphs: The online preparation covers: getting to know Carla and the laser hair removal treatment; anatomy of the skin and how lasering works; understanding and applying the laser hair removal machine, including practical videos; when you may and may not treat; hygiene guidelines; and marketing tips for a flying start.

body.heading: Day 2: Theory & basic skills on location (6 hours)
paragraphs: Morning (9:30 – 11:00): discussing the online theory and deeper study of hygiene, all about the product, an introduction to the laser equipment, plus tips to start up your own salon professionally.

Afternoon (11:30 – 15:30): practical exercises with the machine, followed by practical exercises on a model in which you treat a model with several zones. During the evaluation we discuss the treatment carried out and your personal areas for improvement, and you receive the certificate as the crowning of your hard work.
